indications: OGSIVEO is indicated for adult patients with progressing desmoid tumors who require systemic treatment.
contraindications: The recommended dosage is 150 mg orally twice daily until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. ( 2.1 ) See Full Prescribing Information for dosage modifications due to adverse reactions. ( 2.2 )
warningsAndPrecautions:
OGSIVEO (nirogacestat) is supplied as 100 mg and 150 mg tablets. Each 100 mg light orange, film-coated tablet is debossed with a “100” on one face. Each 150 mg yellow orange, film-coated tablet is debossed with a “150” on one face.
